title: One colour home: fold PatchColors and PatchColorHash into ixdar.graphics.render.color on Color/ColorRGB
description: User request 2026-10-06, after CRAW-45 was found reinventing colour packing. Three palette implementations exist: graphics/render/color/PatchColorHash (a port of the shader's patchColor() hue hash, returns Color), geometry/mesh/data/PatchColors (golden-ratio hues, packed into 0xRRGGBB ints with its own RED_SHIFT/GREEN_SHIFT/RGB_MASK/CHANNEL constants and an hslToRgb, plus a hex form used as flat_color), and RegionColouring from CRAW-45 (adjacency colouring, now on Color/ColorRGB). Move PatchColors into graphics/render/color, express its colours as Color/ColorRGB (keep the packed int and hex only where a caller genuinely needs that format, e.g. flat_color matching a captured pixel, converted at that boundary), and share one HSV/HSL-to-RGB conversion between PatchColors and PatchColorHash instead of two. Callers: MscCellAssembly, PatchDecomposerCLI, MeshOverlayRuntime, HalfEdgeMeshRuntime, the patches Decompose route. No visible change: every patch keeps exactly its colour and hex value. Coordinate with IX-23 (mesh.data reorganisation), which would otherwise move PatchColors too.
definition-of-done: 1. PatchColors lives in graphics/render/color and works in Color/ColorRGB; no class outside a genuine packed-pixel boundary packs or unpacks RGB by hand. 2. One shared hue-to-RGB conversion. 3. A unit test shows every patch id's colour and hex string unchanged for ids 0..1000, and PatchColorHash unchanged. 4. mvn test passes; web build builds.
testing-plan: 1. Golden test of old vs new colours for ids 0..1000 (record the old values first). 2. mvn test and teavm build.
